examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 处理；对付。后接名词、代词或疑问词引导的从句。
collocations: deal with a problem; deal with stress; learn how to deal with sth
commonMistake: deal with 表示处理问题；表示与某人打交道时可用 deal with sb，不能把介词 with 漏掉。

example.chinese: 我们平静地讨论了如何处理这场分歧。
example.english: We talked calmly about how to deal with the disagreement.

application.solution: A。解析：本句指处理问题，用 deal with，短语中的 with 不能省略。
application.prompt: We need to ___ the problem before it becomes worse. A. deal with B. deal

examTags: 词汇·名词与派生词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 情绪；情感，可数，常用复数 emotions。形容词为 emotional。
collocations: strong emotions; control your emotions; express emotion
commonMistake: emotion 是名词，emotional 是形容词；不要用 emotion 直接修饰名词 support。

example.chinese: 音乐可以帮助人们表达自己的情感。
example.english: Music can help people express their emotions.

application.solution: B。解析：full of 后接名词 emotion；emotional 是形容词。
application.prompt: She was so full of ___ that she could hardly speak. A. emotional B. emotion

examTags: 词汇·形容词辨析
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 难过的；沮丧的。常用 be upset about/over sth、be upset with sb；也可作动词“使难过”。
collocations: feel upset; be upset about a mistake; be upset with a friend
commonMistake: 描述人的感受用 upset；描述令人难过的事可用 upsetting。

example.chinese: 朋友没有邀请本，令他感到难过。
example.english: Ben felt upset when his friend did not invite him.

application.solution: A。解析：Mia 是感到难过的人，用 upset；upsetting 描述令人难过的事。
application.prompt: Mia was ___ about the hurtful message. A. upset B. upsetting

examTags: 词汇·近义词辨析
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的，强调主观感受。可作定语或表语。
collocations: feel lonely; a lonely child; lonely at school
commonMistake: lonely 表示感到孤独；alone 表示独自一人，不一定感到寂寞。

example.chinese: 虽然他独自在家，但并不觉得孤独。
example.english: Although he was alone at home, he did not feel lonely.

application.solution: B。解析：He lives alone 表示他独自居住；他享受独处，说明他不感到孤独，用 lonely。
application.prompt: He lives alone and enjoys it, so he is not ___. A. alone B. lonely

examTags: 词汇·形容词辨析
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 震惊的。常用 be shocked at/by sth、be shocked to hear/see；动词为 shock。
collocations: be shocked by the news; feel shocked; shocked to hear that
commonMistake: 人感到震惊用 shocked；引起震惊的消息或事情用 shocking。

example.chinese: 听说学校要关闭，我们感到很震惊。
example.english: We were shocked to hear that the school would close.

application.solution: A。解析：students 是感到震惊的人，用 shocked。
application.prompt: The students were ___ by the sudden announcement. A. shocked B. shocking

examTags: 词汇·动词句型
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 建议；劝告。常用 advise sb to do sth、advise doing sth、advise sb on/about sth；名词为 advice。
collocations: advise a friend; advise sb to rest; advise taking a break
commonMistake: advise 是动词，advice 是不可数名词；“建议某人做某事”用 advise sb to do sth。

example.chinese: 老师建议我们彼此冷静地交谈。
example.english: The teacher advised us to talk to each other calmly.

application.solution: B。解析：本句考查 advise sb to do sth，故选 to get。
application.prompt: The doctor advised him ___ more rest. A. getting B. to get

examTags: 词汇·形容词与语境义
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 伤感情的；令人难过的。常修饰 words、comments、things；名词 hurt 可表示伤害或痛苦。
collocations: hurtful words; a hurtful comment; be hurtful to sb
commonMistake: hurtful 表示会伤害感情的；hurt 是“伤害/感到疼”，不要把二者当作同一词性。

example.chinese: 他为自己说过的伤人的话道了歉。
example.english: He apologized for the hurtful words he had used.

application.solution: A。解析：辱骂别人会伤害对方感情，用 hurtful。
application.prompt: Calling someone names is ___. A. hurtful B. helpful

examTags: 词汇·熟词多义与词形
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 控制；v. 控制、克制。名词短语 take control of；动词过去式/过去分词 controlled。
collocations: lose control; control your anger; take control of a situation
commonMistake: control 作动词变过去式或现在分词时双写 l：controlled、controlling；不要写 controled。

example.chinese: 她深吸了一口气来控制怒火。
example.english: She took a deep breath to control her anger.

application.solution: B。解析：本句描述过去发生的事，control 的过去式是 controlled。
application.prompt: He ___ his anger and spoke politely. A. control B. controlled

examTags: 词汇·名词与派生词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 怒火；愤怒，通常不可数。形容词为 angry；常用 angry with/at sb、angry about sth。
collocations: feel anger; control your anger; full of anger
commonMistake: anger 是名词，angry 是形容词；表示“很生气”说 be angry，不说 be anger。

example.chinese: 她离开房间冷静下来，控制自己的怒火。
example.english: She left the room to calm down and control her anger.

application.solution: B。解析：your 后需要名词 anger；angry 是形容词。
application.prompt: It is important to talk about your ___ instead of shouting. A. angry B. anger

examTags: 词汇·时间短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 今后；从今以后，表示从现在开始往后的时间，常见于英式英语。
collocations: in future, please call first; be more careful in future; in future lessons
commonMistake: in future 表示“今后”；in the future 通常指未来某个时期，注意语境和冠词差异。

example.chinese: 今后，我借姐姐的东西前会先征求她的同意。
example.english: In future, I will ask before borrowing my sister's things.

application.solution: B。解析：本句要求从现在起更加小心，用 in future（今后）。
application.prompt: Please be more careful ___ and check your work before handing it in. A. in the past B. in future

examTags: 词汇·不规则动词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 原谅；宽恕。forgive–forgave–forgiven；常用 forgive sb for sth/doing sth。
collocations: forgive a friend; forgive sb for a mistake; forgive and forget
commonMistake: forgive 的过去式和过去分词分别是 forgave、forgiven；for 后接名词或动名词。

example.chinese: 我原谅了朋友忘记我的生日。
example.english: I forgave my friend for forgetting my birthday.

application.solution: A。解析：has 后用过去分词 forgiven；forgave 是过去式。
application.prompt: She has ___ him for telling the truth too late. A. forgiven B. forgave

examTags: 词汇·名词与固定表达
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 过错；责任，可数或不可数，依结构而定。
collocations: be at fault; admit your fault; find fault with sb
commonMistake: “这是我的错”可说 It is my fault；fault 不是“失败”，不要与 fail 混淆。

example.chinese: 我忘了还书，这是我的过错。
example.english: It was my fault that I forgot to return the book.

application.solution: A。解析：本句指失败应由谁负责，用 fault。
application.prompt: The coach said the loss was nobody's ___. A. fault B. pressure

examTags: 语法·目的与结果状语从句
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: conj. 为了；因此。连接两个分句，so that 后接主语和谓语；可表示目的或结果。
collocations: speak clearly so that everyone can understand; leave early so that we arrive on time; save money so that we can travel
commonMistake: so that 后接完整分句；不要与 so + 形容词/副词 + that 的结构混淆。

example.chinese: 我把计划写下来，以免忘记。
example.english: I wrote down the plan so that I would not forget it.

application.solution: A。解析：空格后是完整分句 everyone could follow his ideas；despite 后应接名词或动名词。
application.prompt: He spoke slowly ___ everyone could follow his ideas. A. so that B. despite

examTags: 词汇·习语表达
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 消除隔阂；尽释前嫌，通常指通过坦诚交谈解决误会或紧张关系。
collocations: talk openly to clear the air; clear the air after an argument; a chance to clear the air
commonMistake: clear the air 是比喻表达，指消除误会或紧张气氛，不是字面“清洁空气”。

example.chinese: 两个朋友坦诚交谈，消除了彼此的隔阂。
example.english: The two friends talked honestly to clear the air.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说交谈以消除误会，用 clear the air。
application.prompt: After their disagreement, they met and talked to ___. A. clear the air B. let them down

examTags: 词汇·熟词多义
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 礼物；v. 展现；陈述；正式呈交。常用 present sth to sb 或 present sb with sth。
collocations: a birthday present; present an idea; present a report to the class
commonMistake: present 作名词表示礼物；作动词表示呈现/陈述，注意与“现在”之义的形容词 present 区分词性。

example.chinese: 每位学生都向全班陈述了一个想法。
example.english: Each student presented one idea to the class.

application.solution: A。解析：本句指生日收到的礼物，用名词 present。
application.prompt: They gave her a beautiful birthday ___. A. present B. pressure

examTags: 词汇·熟词多义
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 标准；水平；adj. 标准的。常用 standard of、meet a standard、high standards。
collocations: a high standard; safety standards; standard English
commonMistake: standard 作名词可指标准或水平，作形容词表示标准的；注意依语境判断词性。

example.chinese: 学校希望学生达到较高的行为标准。
example.english: The school expects students to meet a high standard of conduct.

application.solution: A。解析：clear 后需要名词，表示评判依据用 standard。
application.prompt: The teacher set a clear ___ for the project. A. standard B. pressure

examTags: 词汇·名词与动词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 奖；奖品，可数。常用 win/receive an award for sth；动词 award sb sth 表示授予。
collocations: win an award; receive an award for service; award a prize
commonMistake: award 是奖项或授予；reward 通常指因帮助或努力而给予的报酬，不要混淆。

example.chinese: 玛雅因帮助新生而获奖。
example.english: Maya received an award for helping new students.

application.solution: A。解析：本句指因良好表现获得的奖项，用 award。
application.prompt: The team received an ___ for its fair play. A. award B. fault

examTags: 词汇·习语表达
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 从好的方面想；抱乐观态度。常用 look on the bright side of sth。
collocations: look on the bright side; look on the bright side of a problem; try to look on the bright side
commonMistake: 短语中用 look on the bright side；bright 在这里是“积极、乐观的”，不是字面“明亮的一面”。

example.chinese: 虽然旅行延误了，我们还是尽量往好的方面想。
example.english: Even though the trip was delayed, we tried to look on the bright side.

application.solution: B。解析：本句建议积极面对变化，固定表达是 look on the bright side。
application.prompt: When the plan changes, try to ___ and find a new opportunity. A. look the bright side B. look on the bright side

examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 解释清楚；传达（想法或信息）。常用 get sth across to sb；代词宾语放在 get 和 across 之间。
collocations: get an idea across; get the message across; get it across to sb
commonMistake: 表示“把……传达给某人”用 get sth across to sb；代词要放在 get 和 across 之间。

example.chinese: 教练用一个简单的例子把意思讲清楚。
example.english: The coach used a simple example to get the message across.

application.solution: A。解析：本句指把主要观点传达给听众，结构是 get sth across to sb。
application.prompt: It was difficult to ___ the main idea ___ the audience. A. get; across to B. get; over with

examTags: 词汇·形副转换
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adv. 清楚地；明白地。由 clear + -ly 构成，修饰动词或整句。
collocations: speak clearly; explain clearly; see clearly
commonMistake: clearly 是副词，修饰动词；clear 是形容词，修饰名词或作表语。

example.chinese: 请清楚地表达你的感受，而不是大喊大叫。
example.english: Please explain your feelings clearly instead of shouting.

application.solution: A。解析：本句修饰动词 explained，用副词 clearly。
application.prompt: The referee explained the decision ___. A. clearly B. clear

examTags: 词汇·不可数名词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 压力；压迫，通常不可数。常用 under pressure、put pressure on sb。
collocations: feel pressure; under pressure; put pressure on a friend
commonMistake: pressure 表示心理压力时通常不可数；说“有压力”可用 feel pressure 或 be under pressure。

example.chinese: 在全班面前发言前，她感到有些压力。
example.english: She felt pressure before speaking in front of the class.

application.solution: A。解析：本句泛指心理压力，pressure 通常不可数。
application.prompt: Too much ___ can make it hard to sleep. A. pressure B. pressures

examTags: 词汇·名词与搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 目的；意图，可数。常用 the purpose of sth、for the purpose of doing sth。
collocations: the purpose of the meeting; a clear purpose; serve a purpose
commonMistake: purpose 是“目的”；表示故意用 on purpose，不能说 by purpose。

example.chinese: 这次会议的目的是解决问题。
example.english: The purpose of the meeting was to solve the problem.

application.solution: A。解析：main 后需要名词，询问演讲的主要目的用 purpose。
application.prompt: What is the main ___ of this talk? A. purpose B. purposely

examTags: 词汇·副词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 故意；有意地，作副词短语修饰动作。
collocations: do sth on purpose; break it on purpose; not on purpose
commonMistake: on purpose 表示“故意”；by accident 表示“偶然”，不要把两者混淆。

example.chinese: 我不是故意把你排除在外的。
example.english: I did not leave you out on purpose.

application.solution: B。解析：本句说明他知道规则却仍违反，表示故意，用 on purpose。
application.prompt: He broke the rule ___; he knew it was not allowed. A. by accident B. on purpose

examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 把……切成两半。结构 cut sth in half；被动可说 be cut in half。
collocations: cut an apple in half; cut the paper in half; split the cake in half
commonMistake: 表达“切成两半”用 cut sth in half；in half 表示分成两个相等部分。

example.chinese: 我们把三明治切成两半并分着吃。
example.english: We cut the sandwich in half and shared it.

application.solution: A。解析：本句表示把橙子切成两半，固定说法是 cut sth in half。
application.prompt: Please ___ the orange ___ before sharing it. A. cut; in half B. cut; into half

examTags: 词汇·反身代词与习语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 设身处地；想象自己处于某人的境地。oneself 要与主语一致。
collocations: put yourself in her shoes; put himself in their shoes; try to put yourself in sb’s shoes
commonMistake: 反身代词随主语变化：I—myself，you—yourself，he—himself；不要固定写 oneself。

example.chinese: 在评判他之前，试着设身处地为他想一想。
example.english: Before judging him, try to put yourself in his shoes.

application.solution: B。解析：本句主语是 you，对应反身代词 yourself。
application.prompt: If you were in Mia's situation, you would ___. A. put herself in her shoes B. put yourself in her shoes

examTags: 词汇·不规则动词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 关闭；合上。shut—shut—shut；常用于 shut a door/window、shut your eyes。
collocations: shut the door; shut your eyes; shut a window
commonMistake: shut 的过去式和过去分词仍为 shut，不加 -ed；不要写 shutted。

example.chinese: 他轻轻关上门，以便宝宝能睡觉。
example.english: He shut the door quietly so that the baby could sleep.

application.solution: A。解析：本句是过去时，shut 的过去式仍是 shut。
application.prompt: She ___ the window because it was cold outside. A. shut B. shutted

examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 把……关（藏）起来；隔离。结构 shut sb/sth away；代词宾语放在 shut 和 away 之间。
collocations: shut the dog away; shut it away; shut away old letters
commonMistake: shut ... away 表示把人或物关起来/收起来；代词要说 shut it away，不说 shut away it。

example.chinese: 他们把旧信件收在一个盒子里。
example.english: They shut the old letters away in a box.

application.solution: A。解析：短语动词接代词时，it 放在 shut 和 away 之间。
application.prompt: The noisy puppy was disturbing the guests, so they ___ in another room. A. shut it away B. shut away it

examTags: 词汇·副词辨析
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adv. 最后；最后一点。常用于列举或陈述最后一个观点。
collocations: firstly and lastly; lastly, remember to listen; lastly on the list
commonMistake: lastly 是副词，常用于列举的最后一点；at last 强调等待或困难后终于发生。

example.chinese: 最后，记得感谢帮助过你的人。
example.english: Lastly, remember to thank the people who helped you.

application.solution: B。解析：本句列出最后一项提醒，用 lastly。
application.prompt: ___, let's check that everyone has a seat. A. At least B. Lastly

examTags: 词汇·代词与数量表达
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: pron. 大量；充足。通常与 of 连用构成 plenty of + 可数名词复数/不可数名词。
collocations: plenty of time; plenty of choices; have plenty
commonMistake: plenty 常用 plenty of；不要把它误当成形容词直接放在名词前，如 plenty time。

example.chinese: 练习结束后我们有充足的时间交谈。
example.english: We have plenty of time to talk after practice.

application.solution: A。解析：本句的 food 是不可数名词，plenty of 表示“充足的”。
application.prompt: There is ___ of food for everyone. A. plenty B. many

examTags: 词汇·数量表达
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 大量；充足。后接可数名词复数或不可数名词；谓语通常与后面的名词一致。
collocations: plenty of time; plenty of people; plenty of water
commonMistake: plenty of 可接可数名词复数或不可数名词，如 plenty of information；不要漏掉 of 写成 plenty information。

example.chinese: 今年有很多学生加入了这个队。
example.english: Plenty of students joined the team this year.

application.solution: B。解析：students 是可数名词复数，可用 plenty of 修饰。
application.prompt: ___ students joined the team this year. A. Much of B. Plenty of

examTags: 词汇·情绪习语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 感到忧郁；情绪低落。blue 在此表示悲伤情绪，不是颜色。
collocations: feel blue; feel a little blue; make sb feel blue
commonMistake: feel blue 表示感到忧郁；不要直译成“感觉蓝色”。

example.chinese: 搬离最好的朋友后，她感到有些忧郁。
example.english: She felt blue after moving away from her best friend.

application.solution: A。解析：本句描述失利后的心情，feel blue 表示“感到忧郁”。
application.prompt: After losing the match, Tom felt ___. A. blue B. green

examTags: 词汇·情绪习语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 欢天喜地；感到非常幸福。常用 be/feel on top of the world。
collocations: feel on top of the world; be on top of the world; make sb feel on top of the world
commonMistake: 习语中要保留 the：on top of the world；不能说 on top of world。

example.chinese: 获奖后她高兴极了。
example.english: She felt on top of the world after winning the award.

application.solution: B。解析：本句说 Kai 听到自己获胜后非常开心，用 on top of the world。
application.prompt: When Kai heard that he had won, he was ___. A. in low spirits B. on top of the world

examTags: 词汇·习语与名词复数
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 笑容满面；满脸笑容。常用 be/look all smiles。
collocations: be all smiles; look all smiles; come home all smiles
commonMistake: 固定表达是 all smiles，用复数 smiles；不要写 all smile。

example.chinese: 获胜后，运动员们满脸笑容地离开了球场。
example.english: The players came off the field all smiles after the win.

application.solution: A。解析：本句中表示孩子们满脸笑容，固定表达为 all smiles。
application.prompt: The children were ___ after hearing they could go on the trip. A. all smiles B. all smile

examTags: 词汇·情绪习语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 情绪低落；精神不振。常用 be/feel in low spirits；spirits 在此用复数。
collocations: be in low spirits; feel in low spirits; lift sb's spirits
commonMistake: 表示情绪低落用 in low spirits，spirits 用复数；不要说 in low spirit。

example.chinese: 球队输掉决赛后，他情绪低落。
example.english: He was in low spirits after the team lost the final.

application.solution: B。解析：本句说 Mei 听到坏消息后的状态，用 in low spirits 表示情绪低落。
application.prompt: After the bad news, Mei was ___. A. on top of the world B. in low spirits

examTags: 词汇·不规则动词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 响起铃声；给……打电话。ring—rang—rung；电话义可直接接人，不用 to。
collocations: the bell rings; ring a friend; ring sb back
commonMistake: ring 作“响铃”或“打电话”时词形是不规则变化；打电话给某人说 ring sb，不说 ring to sb。

example.chinese: 我和教练说话时手机响了。
example.english: My phone rang while I was talking to the coach.

application.solution: B。解析：yesterday 表过去；ring 的过去式是 rang。
application.prompt: The school bell ___ at eight yesterday morning. A. ring B. rang

examTags: 词汇·动词结构
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 进入；参加。后接地点或比赛等作宾语。
collocations: enter a room; enter a competition; enter the building
commonMistake: 表示进入房间直接说 enter the room，不加 into；但 enter into 可用于 enter into an agreement 等抽象搭配。

example.chinese: 进房间前请先敲门。
example.english: Please knock before you enter the room.

application.solution: B。解析：表示进入具体地点，enter 后直接接宾语，不加 in。
application.prompt: The players ___ the gym quietly before the game. A. entered in B. entered

examTags: 语法·动词结构
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. & modal v. 敢于；胆敢。作普通动词常用 dare to do；作情态动词时 dare 后接动词原形。
collocations: dare to speak; dare ask a question; How dare you?
commonMistake: 普通动词 dare 常说 dare to do；作情态动词时可省 to，如 dare not go。

example.chinese: 我不敢告诉教练我犯了一个错误。
example.english: I didn't dare to tell the coach that I had made a mistake.

application.solution: B。解析：本句把 dare 当普通动词用，常接不定式 to ask。
application.prompt: As a full verb, she didn't dare ___ the question. A. asking B. to ask

examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 使失望；辜负。常用 let sb down；过去式为 let down。
collocations: let a friend down; let the team down; let sb down again
commonMistake: 代词作宾语时放在中间：let me down；不说 let down me。

example.chinese: 我担心会让队友们失望。
example.english: I was afraid I would let my teammates down.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说不要辜负朋友，用 let sb down。
application.prompt: If you make a promise, don't ___ your friends ___. A. let; down B. let; off

examTags: 语法·主谓一致
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: pron. 每人；所有人，意义上指群体中的每一个人，语法上通常作单数。
collocations: everybody is ready; everybody knows; everybody in the class
commonMistake: everybody 作主语时通常用单数谓语；不说 everybodies 表示复数。

example.chinese: 误会消除后，大家都很高兴。
example.english: Everybody was glad when the misunderstanding was cleared up.

application.solution: B。解析：everybody 作主语，谓语动词用单数 is。
application.prompt: ___ has a chance to speak at the meeting. A. Everybody are B. Everybody is

examTags: 词汇·介词搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 对……苛刻；对……过分严厉。常用 be hard on sb，也可说 be hard on oneself。
collocations: be hard on a player; be hard on yourself; too hard on sb
commonMistake: be hard on sb 表示苛刻对待；be hard for sb 表示某事对某人来说困难，注意介词不同。

example.chinese: 犯了一次错后别对自己太苛刻。
example.english: Don't be too hard on yourself after one mistake.

application.solution: B。解析：本句说教练严厉批评 Ben，表示苛刻对待某人用 be hard on sb。
application.prompt: The coach criticized Ben harshly after the game. He was ___ him. A. hard for B. hard on

examTags: 词汇·名词与派生词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 运动员；选手，可数。
collocations: a team player; a basketball player; a key player
commonMistake: player 指运动员或比赛选手；play 是动词，注意 -er 派生的人。

example.chinese: 每位运动员都认真听教练讲话。
example.english: Every player listened carefully to the coach.

application.solution: B。解析：在运动队中参赛的人是 player；referee 是裁判。

examTags: 词汇·名词辨析
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 裁判，可数。负责确保比赛遵守规则；复数 referees。
collocations: a football referee; the referee's decision; act as a referee
commonMistake: referee 是比赛裁判，coach 是教练；不要把负责判罚的人和训练队伍的人混淆。

example.chinese: 一名运动员受伤后，裁判暂停了比赛。
example.english: The referee stopped the game after a player was hurt.

application.solution: B。解析：本句问负责执行比赛规则的人，是 referee（裁判）。
application.prompt: The person who makes sure players follow the rules is the ___. A. coach B. referee

examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 收回；撤回（说过的话或拿回物品）。代词宾语放在 take 和 back 之间；take 的过去式 took。
collocations: take back a statement; take it back; take back a gift
commonMistake: 表示收回某句话可说 take back what you said；代词要放中间：take it back。

example.chinese: 我当时很生气，但我收回了自己说的话并道了歉。
example.english: I was angry, but I took back what I said and apologized.

application.solution: A。解析：本句要收回说过的话，用 take back。
application.prompt: You said something unkind and now regret it. You should ___ what you said. A. take back B. take up

examTags: 词汇·名词与搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 决定；决策，可数。动词为 decide；常用 make a decision、decision about/on sth、decision to do sth。
collocations: make a decision; a difficult decision; decision to leave
commonMistake: make a decision 表示“作决定”，不要说 do a decision；decision 后可接 to do sth。

example.chinese: 离开队伍是一个艰难的决定。
example.english: It was a hard decision to leave the team.

application.solution: B。解析：本句考查 make a decision；a 后需要名词 decision。
application.prompt: The coach made a ___ to change the training plan. A. decide B. decision

examTags: 词汇·熟词多义
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 得分；比分；v. 得分。常用 score a goal/point、score two goals、the final score。
collocations: score a goal; score points; the final score
commonMistake: score 作名词可指得分或比分，作动词表示得分；表示取得进球常说 score a goal。

example.chinese: 我们队在最后一分钟打进了制胜球。
example.english: Our team scored the winning goal in the last minute.

application.solution: A。解析：本句指比赛的最终比分，用名词 score。
application.prompt: The final ___ was three to two. A. score B. decision

examTags: 词汇·形容词句型

grammar: adj. 骄傲的；自豪的。常用 be proud of sb/sth、be proud to do、be proud that...。
collocations: feel proud; be proud of a friend; proud to help
commonMistake: proud 是形容词；常用 proud of 表示“为……感到自豪”，不要写 proud for。

example.chinese: 她帮助了新同学，父母为她感到自豪。
example.english: Her parents were proud of her for helping the new student.

application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后作表语用形容词 proud。

examTags: 词汇·形容词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 为……感到骄傲；自豪。be proud of 后接名词、代词或动名词。
collocations: be proud of your team; proud of helping others; make sb proud of sth
commonMistake: 固定搭配是 be proud of；of 后接名词或动名词，不接动词原形。

example.chinese: 我很自豪能和这样友善的团队一起工作。
example.english: I am proud of working with such a kind team.

application.solution: B。解析：表示“为某人感到自豪”用 be proud of。
application.prompt: Mum is proud ___ her daughter for telling the truth. A. at B. of

examTags: 词汇·名词熟词多义
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 教练，可数；也可指长途客车（英式英语常见）。
collocations: a football coach; the coach's advice; coach a team
commonMistake: coach 在体育语境中是教练；不要和负责比赛判罚的 referee 混淆。

example.chinese: 输掉比赛后，教练鼓励我们齐心协力。
example.english: Our coach encouraged us to work together after the loss.

application.solution: B。解析：训练并指导队伍的人是 coach（教练）。

examTags: 词汇·副词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 也；又，常放在句末。
collocations: come as well; bring a friend as well; ask the coach as well
commonMistake: as well 通常放在句末；as well as 是“以及/和”，后接并列成分，结构不同。

example.chinese: 你也可以邀请你的弟弟。
example.english: You can invite your brother as well.

application.solution: A。解析：本句句末表示“也”，用 as well。
application.prompt: Lina is joining the meeting, and her brother is coming ___. A. as well B. as well as

examTags: 词汇·数量表达
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 一点；小块；稍微。常用 a bit of + 名词；bit 还可指计算机中的位（较专门义）。
collocations: a bit of food; a bit of advice; bits and pieces
commonMistake: 表示“一点儿”常说 a bit 或 a bit of；不可数名词前要用 a bit of。

example.chinese: 比赛开始前我们还有一点时间。
example.english: We still have a bit of time before the game starts.

application.solution: B。解析：water 是不可数名词，名词前用 a bit of。
application.prompt: Could I have ___ water, please? A. a bit B. a bit of

examTags: 词汇·程度副词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 有点儿；稍微，可修饰形容词或副词；后接名词时用 a bit of。
collocations: a bit tired; a bit slowly; a bit of help
commonMistake: a bit 后可直接接形容词，如 a bit upset；名词前需要 of，如 a bit of time。

example.chinese: 比赛前我感到有点紧张。
example.english: I felt a bit nervous before the game.

application.solution: A。解析：a bit 可直接修饰形容词 cold；a bit of 后需接名词。
application.prompt: The room is ___ cold, so please close the window. A. a bit B. a bit of

examTags: 词汇·动词搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 重复；复述。repeat—repeated—repeated；常用 repeat a word/question、repeat after sb。
collocations: repeat the question; repeat a mistake; repeat after the teacher
commonMistake: repeat 本身含“再做一次”之意，通常不说 repeat again；过去式为 repeated。

example.chinese: 你能把最后一句再慢一点重复一遍吗？
example.english: Could you repeat the last sentence more slowly?

application.solution: A。解析：本句要求再次说出同一句话，用 repeat；reply 表示回答。
application.prompt: The teacher asked Sam to ___ the sentence. A. repeat B. reply

examTags: 词汇·动词短语
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 齐心协力；通力合作，常指困难时大家共同努力。
collocations: pull together as a team; ask everyone to pull together; pull together to solve a problem
commonMistake: pull together 在此表示合作，不是把物体一起拉；常与 team、work、solve 等语境连用。

example.chinese: 我们齐心协力，按时完成了项目。
example.english: We pulled together and finished the project on time.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说队伍想赢就要齐心协力，用 pull together。
application.prompt: The team needs to ___ if it wants to win the final. A. pull together B. shut away

examTags: 词汇·名词搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 解决办法；解决，可数。常用 a solution to a problem；动词为 solve。
collocations: find a solution; a solution to the problem; offer a solution
commonMistake: 表示问题的解决办法用 a solution to，不说 solution of the problem；solve 是动词。

example.chinese: 学生们齐心协力寻找问题的解决办法。
example.english: The students worked together to find a solution to the problem.

application.solution: B。解析：a 后需要名词 solution；solve 是动词。
application.prompt: We need to find a ___ to this disagreement. A. solve B. solution

examTags: 语法·让步状语从句
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: conj. 虽然；尽管，引导让步从句。也可作副词放在句末，表示“不过”。
collocations: though it was late; even though; I liked it, though
commonMistake: though 引导让步从句时主句不再加 but；不能写 Though ..., but ...。

example.chinese: 虽然我累了，我还是留下来帮助队友。
example.english: Though I was tired, I stayed to help my teammate.

application.solution: B。解析：空格后是完整分句 the task was difficult；though 可引导让步从句，despite 后接名词或动名词。
application.prompt: ___ the task was difficult, the group kept working. A. Despite B. Though

examTags: 语法·让步状语从句
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 即使；虽然，引导让步状语从句，后接完整句子。
collocations: even though it is hard; even though she was upset; help even though you are busy
commonMistake: even though 后接主语和谓语；不要再加 but 连接主句。

example.chinese: 即使我们输掉了比赛，我们也学会了团队合作。
example.english: Even though we lost the game, we learned to work as a team.

application.solution: B。解析：本句表示“虽然紧张但仍演讲”，用 even though 引导让步从句。
application.prompt: ___ he felt nervous, he still gave the speech. A. So that B. Even though

examTags: 词汇·介词搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 道歉。常用 apologize to sb for sth/doing sth；名词为 apology；英式拼写 apologise 也正确。
collocations: apologize to a friend; apologize for a mistake; apologize sincerely
commonMistake: apologize 后要用 to 引出道歉对象、for 引出原因；不要说 apologize someone。

example.chinese: 我为自己说话太大声向朋友道了歉。
example.english: I apologized to my friend for speaking too loudly.

application.solution: A。解析：本句结构是 apologize to sb for doing sth，即为忘记会议向队友道歉。
application.prompt: You should ___ forgetting the meeting. A. apologize to your teammate for B. apologize your teammate for

examTags: 词汇·动词短语与词形
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 出错；发生故障；弄错。go—went—gone；常用于 something goes wrong。
collocations: something went wrong; go wrong with the plan; nothing can go wrong
commonMistake: go wrong 表示事情出问题；过去时用 went，不要写 goed wrong。

example.chinese: 公交车出了故障，所以我们迟到了。
example.english: Something went wrong with the bus, so we arrived late.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说计划没按预期进行，表示出了问题，用 went wrong。
application.prompt: The plan did not work as expected. Something ___. A. went wrong B. went well

examTags: 词汇·形名转换
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 高兴的；令人愉快的。名词为 joy；副词为 joyfully。
collocations: a joyful occasion; feel joyful; joyful news
commonMistake: joyful 是形容词，可描述人的感受或令人愉快的事情；joy 是名词。

example.chinese: 父母回家时，孩子们很高兴。
example.english: The children were joyful when their parents came home.

application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后作表语需要形容词 joyful；joy 是名词。
application.prompt: The children were ___ after hearing the good news. A. joy B. joyful

examTags: 词汇·形容词句型
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 感谢的；感激的。常用 be thankful to sb for sth、be thankful that...。
collocations: be thankful to a friend; thankful for help; feel thankful
commonMistake: 表示感谢某人用 thankful to sb；感谢某事/帮助用 thankful for sth。

example.chinese: 我很感激队友们对我的支持。
example.english: I am thankful to my teammates for their support.

application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后作表语用形容词 thankful；for 引出感谢的原因。
application.prompt: We are ___ for your kind advice. A. thank B. thankful

examTags: 词汇·形容词语境义
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adj. 否定的；消极的。名词 negativity；可修饰 answer、attitude、effect 等。
collocations: a negative answer; a negative attitude; negative effects
commonMistake: negative 可表示“否定的”或“消极的”，根据语境判断；修饰名词用形容词，不用副词 negatively。

example.chinese: 尽量不要只关注负面的评论。
example.english: Try not to focus only on negative comments.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说回答内容是否定的，用 negative。
application.prompt: A reply that says “no” is a ___ answer. A. negative B. positive

examTags: 词汇·名词与动词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: n. 恶霸；霸凌者；v. 欺凌；恐吓。名词复数 bullies；动词过去式 bullied。
collocations: a school bully; bully a classmate; stand up to a bully
commonMistake: bully 作动词变过去式时 y 变 i 加 -ed：bullied；名词复数为 bullies。

example.chinese: 那名年长的学生在学校欺凌一个年纪较小的男孩。
example.english: The older student bullied a younger boy at school.

application.solution: B。解析：因为别人不同而欺凌他人，用动词 bully。

examTags: 词汇·介词搭配
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 冲……喊叫；对某人吼叫，常带生气或责备语气。
collocations: shout at a friend; shout at sb angrily; stop shouting at each other
commonMistake: shout at sb 常指生气地冲某人喊；为了让远处的人听见，可用 shout to sb。

example.chinese: 他冲弟弟喊了一声，之后道了歉。
example.english: He shouted at his brother and then apologized.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说生气时不要冲人喊叫，用 shout at。
application.prompt: If you are angry, try talking calmly instead of ___ people. A. shouting at B. listening to

examTags: 词汇·动词与派生词
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: v. 表现；举止得体。常用 behave well/badly、behave oneself；名词为 behaviour/behavior。
collocations: behave politely; behave well at school; behave oneself
commonMistake: behave 是动词；修饰它用副词 well/politely，不用形容词 good/polite。

example.chinese: 参观期间，学生们举止很有礼貌。
example.english: The students behaved politely during the visit.

application.solution: B。解析：should 后接动词原形 behave；behaviour 是名词。

examTags: 词汇·形副转换
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: adv. 不同地；以不同方式。形容词为 different；名词为 difference。
collocations: think differently; treat people differently; behave differently
commonMistake: differently 是副词，修饰动词；be 后描述状态通常用 different。

example.chinese: 这次我们用不同的方法解决了问题。
example.english: We solved the problem differently this time.

application.solution: A。解析：本句修饰动词 played，用副词 differently。
application.prompt: The two teams played ___ in the second half. A. differently B. different

grammar: n. 物理；物理学，学科名称，通常不可数；作主语时谓语用单数。
collocations: study physics; a physics lesson; physics is difficult
commonMistake: physics 虽以 -s 结尾，但学科名通常作单数：Physics is...；不说 physics are。

example.chinese: 物理是我今年最喜欢的学科。
example.english: Physics is my favorite subject this year.

application.solution: B。解析：physics 作学科名是单数，谓语用 is。

examTags: 词汇·不规则动词辨析

grammar: v. 平躺；平放。lie—lay—lain—lying；常用 lie down。
collocations: lie on the sofa; lie down for a rest; lie still
commonMistake: 表示“躺”时过去式是 lay、过去分词是 lain；不要与“说谎”的 lie—lied—lied 混淆。

example.chinese: 他躺在草地上看云。
example.english: He lay on the grass and watched the clouds.

application.solution: B。解析：表示“躺”的 lie 过去式是 lay；lied 表示“说谎”的过去式。
application.prompt: Yesterday, she ___ down because she felt tired. A. lied B. lay

grammar: adj. 醒着的。常用 be/stay/keep awake；通常作表语，放在 be、stay 等动词后。

commonMistake: awake 通常放在 be/stay 等动词后作表语；表示“醒来”用 wake up。

example.chinese: 弟弟回家时我还醒着。
example.english: I was still awake when my brother came home.

application.solution: A。解析：stay 后接形容词 awake，表示保持醒着。

grammar: phr. 醒来；叫醒。wake 的过去式是 woke；及物用法中代词宾语放在 wake 和 up 之间。
collocations: wake up early; wake sb up; wake me up
commonMistake: “叫醒某人”说 wake sb up；代词要放在中间：wake me up。

example.chinese: 上学日我七点醒来。
example.english: I wake up at seven on school days.

application.solution: A。解析：代词 me 作宾语要放在 wake 和 up 之间。
application.prompt: Please ___ me ___ at six tomorrow. A. wake; up B. wake up; me

grammar: adj. 放松的；镇定的，描述人的感受或状态。动词 relax；relaxing 描述令人放松的事物。
collocations: feel relaxed; stay relaxed; relaxed about the result
commonMistake: 人感到放松用 relaxed；让人放松的音乐或活动用 relaxing。

example.chinese: 和朋友交谈后，她感到放松了。
example.english: She felt relaxed after talking with her friend.

application.solution: B。解析：us 是感到放松的人，用 relaxed。

grammar: adj. 正常的；普通的。常用 be normal、back to normal、normal for sb。
collocations: a normal day; return to normal; it is normal to feel nervous
commonMistake: normal 是形容词，副词为 normally；不要用 normal 修饰动词。

example.chinese: 大型比赛前感到紧张是正常的。
example.english: It is normal to feel nervous before a big game.

application.solution: B。解析：seems 后作表语需要形容词 normal。

example.chinese: 我们仍然会不时给彼此打电话。
example.english: We still call each other from time to time.

application.solution: A。解析：本句说他不时去拜访教练，用 from time to time。

grammar: adj. 很生气；疯狂的。美式英语常用 mad 表示生气；英式英语中常表示疯的，语境决定。
collocations: be mad at/with sb; drive sb mad; mad about sth
commonMistake: mad at/with sb 可表示生某人的气；mad 也可表示疯狂，注意英美用法和上下文。

example.chinese: 她因忘记团队会议而生自己的气。
example.english: She was mad at herself for forgetting the team meeting.

application.solution: B。解析：朋友违背了承诺，他因此生气，用 mad at。
application.prompt: He was ___ at his friend for breaking the promise. A. glad B. mad

grammar: adj. 刻薄的；吝啬的。常用 be mean to sb、be mean with money。
collocations: be mean to a classmate; a mean comment; be mean with money
commonMistake: mean 作形容词可表示“刻薄的”或“吝啬的”；不要与动词 mean（意思是）混淆。

example.chinese: 他嘲笑她的错误，这样做很刻薄。
example.english: It was mean of him to laugh at her mistake.

application.prompt: Someone who never wants to share or spend money may be ___. A. generous B. mean
application.solution: B。解析：本句说不愿分享或花钱，mean 表示“吝啬的”。

grammar: adj. 深的；有……深的。常用 be ... deep、deep water；副词 deeply，名词 depth。
collocations: deep water; a deep hole; two metres deep
commonMistake: 表示深度常说 two metres deep；不要用介词 of 接数值说 two metres of deep。

example.chinese: 游泳池这一端有两米深。
example.english: The pool is two metres deep at this end.

application.solution: B。解析：本句描述河的深度，用数值 + deep。
application.prompt: The river is about three metres ___. A. deeply B. deep

grammar: phr. 深呼吸；吸一口气。常用 take a deep breath before doing sth。
collocations: take a deep breath; take a slow breath; breathe deeply
commonMistake: 固定说 take a breath，不说 make a breath；deep 是形容词，修饰名词 breath。

example.chinese: 回答前，他深吸了一口气并保持冷静。
example.english: Before answering, he took a deep breath and stayed calm.

application.solution: A。解析：本句用 take a deep breath 表示深吸一口气；breath 是名词。

grammar: phr. 去世；逝世，委婉表达，通常不及物。过去式 passed away。
collocations: pass away peacefully; a relative passed away; after sb passes away
commonMistake: pass away 是不及物短语，不用被动语态；过去叙事时 pass 变为 passed。

example.chinese: 他的祖父去年冬天安详地去世了。
example.english: His grandfather passed away peacefully last winter.

application.solution: A。解析：本句使用委婉说法“去世”，用 pass away，不用被动语态。

grammar: pron. 任何人。常用于疑问句、否定句和条件句；肯定句泛指任何人时也可用。
collocations: anybody else; anybody can join; not know anybody here
commonMistake: anybody 作主语时通常接单数谓语；与 everybody 一样，不加 -s 变复数。

example.chinese: 有人知道裁判去哪儿了吗？
example.english: Does anybody know where the referee went?

application.solution: B。解析：本句条件从句中 anybody 作主语，谓语用单数 needs。

examTags: 词汇·动词结构

grammar: v. 继续存在；保持不变；仍然处于某状态。常用 remain + 形容词/名词、remain in a place。
collocations: remain calm; remain friends; remain unchanged
commonMistake: remain 可直接接形容词作表语，如 remain calm；不要在 remain 后再加 be。

example.chinese: 裁判改判后，运动员们仍保持冷静。
example.english: The players remained calm after the referee changed the decision.

application.solution: A。解析：remain 后可接形容词作表语；remain unsolved 表示“仍未解决”。
application.prompt: Even after the discussion, the main problem remained ___. A. unsolved B. unsolving

examTags: 语法·并列结构
中考·情绪调节与人际沟通
grammar: phr. 不但……而且……；连接并列的词、短语或分句，连接成分应保持平行。
collocations: not only kind but also helpful; not only sing but also dance; not only the players but also the coach
commonMistake: not only A but also B 连接并列成分；若置于句首引出倒装，not only 后的分句需部分倒装。

example.chinese: 不仅运动员们感谢了裁判，教练也感谢了裁判。
example.english: Not only the players but also the coach thanked the referee.

application.solution: A。解析：本句用 not only ... but also ... 连接并列形容词 responsible 和 kind。
application.prompt: The student is ___ responsible ___ kind to new classmates. A. not only; but also B. either; but
